policy: Fixed descriptive baselines; no training or threshold selection on evaluation labels. Historical structural solution inspection already occurred; this is not a blind competition submission.
parameter_basis: Noise levels, windows, thresholds, group caps and balanced scenario frequencies are declared engineering sensitivity settings, not estimates from SMEs or thresholds validated for automation. Baselines remain fixed regardless of test outcomes.
